Title: Check the optional history item and date fields

Step Action: Log into CareFlow with Generate Care Plan access and open Generate Care Plan > Additional Items for a patient with Intensity/Touch Level history.
Step Expected: Intensity/Touch Level History is available as an optional checkbox below Intensity/Touch Level.

Step Action: Select the Intensity/Touch Level History checkbox.
Step Expected: From and To date fields are displayed and allow the user to select a date range.

Title: Check the default date range and three-year limit

Step Action: Open Generate Care Plan > Additional Items for a patient with history spanning more than three years and select Intensity/Touch Level History.
Step Expected: From and To default to the available three-year range. A message informs the user that up to three years of history is available.

Step Action: Modify From and To to a shorter range within the available period.
Step Expected: The selected dates are accepted and remain available for Care Plan generation.

Step Action: Attempt to select a From or To date outside the available three-year range using the date picker and direct entry if supported.
Step Expected: Dates outside the available range cannot be used to generate the history.

Title: Check generated history respects the selected date range

Step Action: Use a patient with known history records inside and outside a chosen date range within the last three years. Open Generate Care Plan and select Intensity/Touch Level History.
Step Expected: The history option is selected and From and To fields are available.

Step Action: Set From and To to the chosen date range and generate the Care Plan.
Step Expected: The generated Care Plan includes all expected Intensity/Touch Level history records within the selected range and excludes records outside it.

Step Action: Generate another Care Plan using the default three-year range for a patient with records both within that range and older than three years.
Step Expected: History within the available three-year range is included. Records older than that range are excluded.

Title: Check history section location and record details

Step Action: Generate a Care Plan including Care Management Programs and Intensity/Touch Level History for a range containing known records with and without comments.
Step Expected: An Intensity/Touch Level History section appears below Care Management Programs.

Step Action: Compare the history table with the patient's source history records.
Step Expected: The table displays Change Date, Changed By, Touch Level Change, and Comments. Dates, users, and Touch Level changes match the source records.

Step Action: Check one record with a comment and one without a comment.
Step Expected: The entered comment appears in the Comments column. The record without a comment displays --.

Title: Check history is omitted when not selected

Step Action: Open Generate Care Plan > Additional Items for a patient with history. Select Intensity/Touch Level History and then clear its checkbox.
Step Expected: Intensity/Touch Level History is not selected for inclusion.

Step Action: Generate and view the Care Plan.
Step Expected: The Care Plan does not include an Intensity/Touch Level History section or its records.

Title: Check current Low Touch text at the top of the Care Plan

Step Action: Use a patient whose current intensity level is Low Touch and generate a Care Plan with the current intensity level included.
Step Expected: The top of the Care Plan displays Current Intensity Level: Low Touch instead of the standalone text Low Touch.
